attributes.context: Article XXXIV provides severance pay for displacement due to plant or depot closing and labor-saving equipment, with three-year eligibility, a half-week-of-pay benefit for each year of service, a 23-half-week cap, exclusions for reasonable employment offers and voluntary resignation, and a separate exception for displacement after seniority when hourly rated routes reduce commission routes.

extraction_text: Employees displaced and terminated due to the closing of a plant or depot and the discontinuance of its operations, due to the introduction of labor-saving equipment, shall be entitled to severance pay subject to the following requirements and qualifications:

attributes.context: This provision is in the severance pay article and follows sections establishing eligibility, benefit amounts, maximums, and exclusions; it expressly extends severance to all regular employees displaced by the employer instituting hourly rated routes and reducing commission routes.

extraction_text: E. Notwithstanding the eligibility requirements set forth in Section A above, all regular employees covered by this Agreement shall be entitled to severance pay as provided above if such employee is laid off, after the exercise of his seniority rights, because his Employer had instituted hourly rated routes and reduced the number of commission routes.
